problem: Exact-main production served the pricing page with the i18n stylesheet marker but without /assets/js/i18n.js. The runtime therefore never mounted any language selector; browser diagnostics showed allSelects=0 even after opening the active mobile navigation.
root_cause: The primary defect was tools/site-shell/apply-i18n.mjs treating any shared data-bg-i18n-asset marker as proof that the full i18n bundle already existed. Because pricing already contained assets/i18n.css, the transformer returned before injecting assets/js/i18n.js and before mobile-control injection. A secondary compatibility requirement is that assets/js/i18n.js must include the active #v18MobileDrawer among its mobile hosts.
prevention: Detect and inject assets/i18n.css and assets/js/i18n.js independently; one existing asset must never suppress the other.
Always run idempotent mobile language-control injection after asset reconciliation.
Treat #v18MobileDrawer as a first-class runtime mobile host while preserving generic and legacy hosts.
Prove final production HTML contains both i18n assets, then execute a visible NL->EN->NL browser roundtrip.
Exact Netlify commit_ref proves deployment identity only; LIVE_BEWEZEN still requires functional language-switch proof and no visible switching-failed error.

evaluation.expected_invariant: final production HTML independently contains i18n CSS and JS; the active mobile navigation exposes exactly one usable language selector and production completes NL->EN->NL
